content: God dikidi Mawul Yipisas tipa kidiy duw dayadiy mawulaar wulaad.

Apalas Korin tipaam kwadik, Pol nibwuk ridiy tamiyaar yikuw, Yipisasaar ata wakwud. Alim nuwukadiy Kristen sitakirakuw, di ata bas sididiy, “Gwur Jisasak wukijibir tigwuril, God dikidi Mawul kwurgwurid, ay? Day ata wadaad, “Nyan God dikidi Mawulaam maa laakw.”

Pol ata bas sididiy, “Agwa baptais kwurgwuril?” Day wadaad, “Nyan Jon diki baptais a kwurbaal.” Wadaak, Pol wadidiy, “Duw taakw day dayadiy valik bwan kwiykuw, Jon diki baptais kwurdaal. Di Yisrayil duw takwak yarik yididiy nikidi duw diki kwukir yakinaad. Day adi duwak wukijibir tikidanaad wakuw. Adi duw di Jisasad.”
Day a jaav lakwukuw, baptais ata kwurdiy Jisas dikidi saam.
Pol taab dayaam takakuw, God dikidi Mawul dayaam dakuw, day ata niki kwudiy niki kwudiyir bwulaan God diki maaj wasapwiydaal.
Duw tabatiy maan vitiy atawa kwurdiy.
Nabiy vitiy Pol God diki maaj wasapwiydil Yipisasaam.
Pol Juw dayadi gaba maja wiyaar wulakuw, alim di dayak Viyakita Maaj wasapwiyid. Bap mugwul atawa kwurdidiy. Di dayawa maaj warjuwid God diki duw takwak van tikidadiy nyak.

Aw nuwukadiy day diki maaj wukijibir ti maarkuw, day kupwarapa maaj wadiy Jisasak, duw taakw vagaruwdaal tamiyaam tikuw. Atawa wadaak, Pol ata wapadidiy. Nuwukadiy Kristen kwurkuw, Tiranas dikidi duw takwak kalivadadi wiyaam nyanyi Pol kalivadidiy.
Nabiy vitiy atawa kwurkuw, ababa Asiya tamiyaam kwadiy duw taakw, Juwawa nuwukadiy jaka tipa kidiy duw taakw, day abab Yitaypika Duw diki maaj wukidaal.
Sikiyva dikidiy duwa nyanugw
God Polak ap kwiykuw, di nimadiy yawiy kwurdidiy. Tayir adiy duw taakw atampika yawiy day maa vi.

Pol dikidiy wag vagata wapwiywa, yawiy kidiy wapwiywa diki sipaam takadik, nuwukadiy duw taakw kwurkuw, giviyib kwurdiy duw takwak karaydadiy. Day adiy giviyib ata kwusidiy. Nuwukadiy dayadiy mawulaam kwadiy wudib ata wapadadiy.
Nuwukadiy Juw day yin yaan tibagwun duw taakw dayadiy mawulaam kwadiy wudib sipwutiyik. Dayadiy mawul wadiy, “Kidiy wudib pwutiykwadiy kidi Pol wasapwiydidi Jisas dikidi saam.”
Juw dayadi yitaypika pris, dikidi si Sikiyva, dikidiy duwa nyanugw abitiy atawa kwurdiy.
Aw adi wudib dayak wadidiy, “Jisas lakwu-tuwaad. Aw Pol ab lakwu-tuwaad. Aw gwur agwa duw-adiygwur?”
Wakuw, wudib mawulaam kwadidi duw dayaam nimadib viyakuw, kakildidiy. Kakilkuw, adi wiy day wapakuw, tabwudiy. Dayadiy sip kupwaraap tidiy. Aw day duwadika tabwudiy.
Ababa Yipisasaam kwadiy Juwawa nuwukadiy tipa kidiy duw taakw a jaav wukikuw, day yagadiy. Yagakuw, day samasam wukidiy Yitaypika Duw Jisasak.
Samasama duw taakw wukijibir tikuw, vagaluwdiy duw takwak wadadiy ababa vaal tayir kwurdadiy.
Nuwukadiy tayir day kupwarapa yanuw kwurdiy, day dayadiy yanuw lapa nyig karaykuw, yiyaam takadadiy duw taakw daya vagaruwdaal tamiyaam. Adiy lapa nyig yapiy-kwadaal saan K10,000.
Duw taakw atawa kwurdaak, Yitaypika Duw diki maaj bwutaay niki tip niki tipaar yal. Aw aka bwutaay nima tal.
Kayik kwurdiy bapa duw maa wadiy Polak.
Atawa tikuw, God dikidi Mawul Polak wadik, Pol ata waad, “Wun Masitaniya, Gris, abir tamiyaar yikuw, Jiruwsalimaar ata yikidiwun. Jiruwsalimaar yikuw, alim kwakuw, Romaar ata yikidiwun.”
Wakuw, dikiwa yawiy kwurbir duw Timotiyawa Yirastas di wayakidik, Masitaniy-aar yibir. Pol di nuwukadiy nyi Asiya tamiyaam kwadidiy.
A sikir nuwukadiy duw day maa wakuw adiy Kristenak, jawjaay kwurdiy dayaam.

Aw duw nak, dikidi si Dimitiriyas, di silva yawiy kwurid. Di silva ar kwasadiy kayik yitaka-didiy. Suwala god til taakw liki si Atimis, likidi gaba maja wiya kayik-adiy. Di dikidiy yawiy duwawa saan samasam kwurdiy a yawiyik.
Adi duw, nuwukadiy duw diki yawiy pik kwurdiy duw, dayak gaam sididiy. Yakuw, vagaluwdaak, wadidiy, “Gwur duw, gwur abab lakwu-nadiygwur nyan saan samasam kwurkwanadiyan nyana yawiyik.

“Pol dikidiy kwurdidiy yawiy gwur vikuw, lakwugwura. Di wakwanaad adiy duw dayadiy kwurdadiy kayik adiy mwiya god maa. Aw Yipisasawa miyawa Asiya tamiyaam rinadiy tipaam kwanadiy duw taakw samasam wukijibir tinadiy diki majik.

“Aw Pol diki maaj nyanadiy yawiyim jawjaay kwurik wadaala. Asiyawa ababa tipa kidiy duw taakw day gaba maaj sukwu-kwanadiy Atimisak. Aw li day Pol diki maaj wukikidana, aal wakinadiy nyana nima god Atimis li yisadapik tikina.”
Aw ababa vagaluwdiy duw a maaj wukikuw, day gaam sidiy, “Yipisas daya god Atimis li mwiya yitaypik tina.”

Gaam sikuw, day yin yaan gipibagwudiy. Titaay, nimadib wariya kwudiy wadiy. Gayasawa Aristakas, abir Masitaniya tamiya kibir duw, bir Polawa yin yaan tibagwubir. Aw adiy duw birakim kalakwukuw, daya vagaruwdadi tamiyaar liyin karaydabir. Day abab birakiwa arir ata gipidiy.
Aw Pol di adiy vagaluwdiy duw daya nyidir yikir. Aw adiy Kristen maa wadiy di yiyak.
Aw nuwukadiy gavman duw, day Pol dikidiy kapa duwadiy, day maaj wayakidaal dikik. Day bas sidika sidaad di yi maa arir viyak-danaad.
Adiy vagaluwdiy duw taakw mawul jawjaay tidiy. Nuwuk niki majir gaam sidiy. Aw nuwuk niki majir gaam sidiy. Samasam day maa laakw, “Agwa javik yaan vagaruwnadiyan?” wakuw wadiy.

Nuwukadiy Juw Aliksadaam vikuw, wadaad, “Min maay! Yin maaj lakatiy-minkik!” Nyidir wapasakwudaak, duw taakw wadiy, “Ki vaal kidi duw dikila.” Aw Aliksada taab kwusuwdik, day kaygan maa ti. Di dayak maaj kwiyik. Aw day wukidaal di Juw bapa duw tad, day alik niki majir gaam sidiy, “Yipisas daya takwa god, Atimis, li mwiya nimaala!” Aua vitiy atawadika gaam san tidiy.
Yipisas dayad kuskus vagaluwdiy duw dayadiy kwudiy watipididiy.

Aua vitiy yibir, Yipisas dayadi kuskus maaj watipididiy. Day kaygan tidaak, wadidiy, “Yipisas tipa kidiy duw, ababa duw taakw lakwunadiy nima Atimis likidi gaba maja wiyawa adi maaj tinadi kabaak adawur tipaam daad kidi kupwaar. Abir javik nyan Yipisas duw van tinadiyan.
“Duw nakab samab wu maa ki maaj suwala maajal waan. Aal mwiya maaja. Atawa tikuw, gwuradiy mawul wardaba. Gwur yabiyib kupwarapa jaav kwurway.
“Gwur kibir duw kilir kwurin kariya-gwurabir. Aw bir nyanadiy gaba maja wiyaam rinadiy jaav bir luwkuw maa kwar. Bir sapis jikin maa kwar nyana takwa god ak.
“Aw li Dimitiriyas ay nuwukadiy duw day maaj tinadiy, kot nyi kidiyka kip rinadiy. Jas ab kidiyka kwanadiy. Nuwukadiy duwak alim maaj bwula-kinadiygwur.
“Aw gwuraam niki jaav rikila, aw duw vagaluw-kinadiy maaj bwulakina nyaam a jaav lakatiyik.
Gwurawa nyan wariya-banalik, Rom dayadiy sapakwa nyanugw wukikuw, jawjaay kwurkidanadiyan nyanaam. Ki wariya maaj liki maaw maa ri. Nyanak wakidana, ata ata wakibanadiy?”
Dayak ata wakuw, wapakuw, ata yidiy.
